title: AI-Generated Weekly & Quarterly Team Productivity Reports from Asana
summary: Task data is pulled from Asana, stored for history, analysed by an AI model and emailed to stakeholders every week and every quarter.
headline: AI reports on how your team is really doing
problem: Understanding who completed what, what was delayed and why meant manual reporting.
solution: n8n pulls task data from the Asana API into Supabase, tracking creations, completions, delays and due-date changes. Every week it computes completion rates and workload per person, an OpenAI model writes the analysis and recommendations, and the report is emailed. A quarterly run does the same for long-term trends.
highlights: Completion rate and pending workload per user
role: Sole engineer. I built the data pipeline, the analysis logic, the AI prompts and the email delivery.
